{{Quote|Many Hutt foods are quite delicious, including this "punky muffin" sandwich. A breakfast favorite on Nar Shaddaa, it features a poached gorg egg, Klatooine paddy frog sausage and a slice of jerba cheese on a pedunkee mufkin.|Dex's Diner menu, on the "Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Pedunkee mufkins''' also known as "punky muffins" were a type of [[Muffin/Legends|muffin]] that could be eaten by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They were used to make the [["Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich]], a [[Foodstuff/Legends|breakfast]] favorite<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] included a [[poached gorg egg]], [[Klatooine paddy frog sausage]], and a slice of [[jerba cheese]], all on a pedunkee mufkin. "Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwiches were also sold for 6.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as part of the breakfast favorites at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The most gracious Jabba has one more small condition: he demands you bring back the slime who kidnapped his little&hellip;punky muffin.|[[TC-70/Legends|TC-70]], translating [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba The Hutt]].|audio=PunkyMuffin-TCWf.flac|<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
Pedunkee mufkin was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
